## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests cover the observable behavior change, or the reason a test is not appropriate is explained above.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or terminology changes (`README.md`, `GLOSSARY.md`, `docs/adr/`).
- [ ] No generated files (`target/`), secrets, or security-sensitive details are included. Security issues go through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/LoganBaird-Levenick/portfree/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
